steps.title: Count orders and distinct customers
steps.change: Order volume and customer reach count different things. Orders is the only source because the report's headline measures all describe transactions and each row already supplies order ID, customer ID, amount and date.

steps.title: Compute order value metrics
steps.change: The sum and average use each order amount.
steps.added_sql:
SELECT SUM(Total_Order_Amount) AS total_order_value,
       ROUND(AVG(Total_Order_Amount), 2) AS avg_order_value

steps.title: Add the first and last dates
steps.change: The date bounds must describe the entire set of orders.
steps.added_sql:
SELECT COUNT(OrderID) AS total_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS ordering_customers,
       SUM(Total_Order_Amount) AS total_order_value,
       ROUND(AVG(Total_Order_Amount), 2) AS avg_order_value,
       MIN(OrderDate) AS first_order_date,
       MAX(OrderDate) AS last_order_date
